positions.title: Senior Software Engineer (Rail Simulation)
positions.description: Building and maintaining train simulation software in C++ with a focus on safety-critical railway systems.

positions.title: Software Engineer (Railway)
positions.description: Consultant at CORYS, developing high-fidelity railway simulation software for Positive Train Control (PTC) systems.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer (Startup | Cybersecurity) - Deep Learning
positions.description:
Developed advanced data pipelines and detection algorithms to analyze network traffic

Led the design and implementation of a robust netflow processing framework that optimized network threat detection and response times.

Implemented anomaly detection mechanisms to flag unusual behaviors, including port scanning and Command & Control patterns, improving the accuracy of threat detection.

Collaborated with a multidisciplinary team to produce threat intelligence reports, contributing directly to client network security by identifying and mitigating potential threats.

Improved pipeline performance, reducing analysis time and supported scalability initiatives to handle larger volumes of network data.
positions.insights: Skills: Machine Learning · Software Development · MongoDB · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Network Traffic Analysis · Scrum · Data Science · GitHub · Python (Programming Language) · MySQL · Agile Methodologies · SCADA · TensorFlow · Data Pipelines

positions.title: Research & Development Software Engineer (Railway)
positions.description:
Developed a SIL4-certified odometry system in C++ for train control, ensuring accurate speed and position tracking even in GNSS-limited areas, and adhered to EN-50128 standards.

Designed a SCADA system for real-time monitoring of station subsystems, integrating with Automatic Train Supervision (ATS) over TCP/IP and deploying on Linux servers.

Defined and managed Interface Specifications, Software Requirements, and Test Specifications in DOORS, ensuring full compliance and traceability.

Conducted code updates, integration tests, and peer reviews, collaborating closely with clients to validate software reliability.
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · Jira · SharePoint · Software Development · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Scrum · GitHub · Rational DOORS · Agile Methodologies · SCADA · Java

positions.title: Junior Software Engineer (I.T Department Intern)
positions.description:
Developed an interactive organization chart using HTML, CSS and JavaScript.

Improved, speeded up and minimized human errors within the finances department by automating the generation of budget reports using Excel Macros and Visual Basic.
